notes: This contract records Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 timestamped regional interaction slice: owner-created committed regions, active-region overlap planning, constrained and nonconstrained overlap-qualified recipients captured in a federation-owned recipient ledger, TSO queueing before Time Advance Grant for the constrained recipient, callback-gated delivery, sent-region callback propagation, lower-bound validation, pending-fanout suppression, and a legal post-delivery Request Retraction callback for the delivered nonconstrained recipient. The shared predicate includes the separately documented exact-boundary Allow Relaxed DDM policy, but these timestamped cases exercise only strict-overlap and do not independently validate that policy. A direct disjoint-region regression additionally proves that a qualifying timestamped Send Interaction With Regions returns a valid designator even when no subscription overlaps; the ledger supports legal Retract and later terminal classification without retaining typed interaction payload. Passive regional pairs are excluded by the shared planner, but this timestamped contract does not independently test their mode transition. It does not claim object-region services, broader relaxed-DDM matrices, alternate advance modes, save/restore, transport, catalog evidence, or conformance.
